record.oneLiner: A horn-nosed theropod predator of the Late Jurassic.
record.description: Ceratosaurus was a carnivorous theropod of the Late Jurassic of North America and Europe, distinguished by a prominent horn on its snout and small hornlets over its eyes. It shared the Morrison Formation with the larger predator Allosaurus.

notableFacts.text: Bore a distinctive blade-like horn on its snout.
Had a row of small bony osteoderms down its back.
